title: City Council Approves Transit Funding Expansion
summary: The council approved a multi-year plan to expand light rail and bus service across Gotham.
body: After months of debate, Gotham's city council voted to fund a major transit expansion, adding new light-rail routes and extending late-night bus service to the East End.

title: Wayne Enterprises Unveils Clean-Energy Microgrid
summary: Wayne Enterprises announced a citywide clean-energy microgrid pilot for downtown Gotham.
body: Wayne Enterprises revealed a clean-energy microgrid that could power downtown Gotham with renewable storage, promising lower costs and far fewer blackouts during peak demand.

title: Gotham Museum Reopens Its Restored Grand Wing
summary: The Gotham Museum reopened its grand wing after a two-year restoration.
body: The Gotham Museum welcomed visitors back to its restored grand wing, showcasing recovered murals and a new photography gallery with sweeping views of the city skyline.

title: Downtown Startups Draw Record Investment
summary: Gotham's startup district posted a record quarter for venture funding.
body: Investors poured record capital into Gotham's downtown startup district this quarter, with fintech and clean-tech firms leading a new wave of hiring.
